谢谢，亚子、LOCK……！

ui_voice_status_002#4.name: run

可以吗？那我就……

ui_voice_status_003#4.name: run

呜呜，怎么办……

那、那种吓人的就别了吧……？

ui_voice_status_006#4.name: run

因、因为，好害羞嘛～……

ui_voice_status_009#4.name: run

为什么突然要去泳池……？

ui_voice_status_010#4.name: run

ui_voice_status_011#4.name: run

ui_voice_status_014#4.name: run

ui_voice_status_015#4.name: run

哇、啊啊……！小Kitty……！

ui_voice_status_016#4.name: run

演出时的小LOCK好帅气啊……

ui_voice_status_017#4.name: run

ui_voice_status_018#4.name: run
